blocks.orig: Hakuna Majiwe Beach Lodge is a beachfront retreat in Paje on Zanzibar’s east coast. It boasts 20 bandas – each carefully and stylishly decorated providing maximum comfort and serenity during your stay. It offers garden rooms for two people, double ocean view rooms for a maximum of three people, and family garden view rooms comprising two bedrooms. Each banda is fitted with traditional handcrafted furniture, a four-poster bed with mosquito net, Wi-Fi and a generous ensuite bathroom… not to mention a private terrace with a swing, overlooking the turquoise-blue ocean! Enjoy a jump in the pool, relax on the sun loungers or try a cocktail from the pool bar. The restaurant serves authentic Swahili-Zanzibari cuisine with fresh locally harvested vegetables.
blocks.html: Hakuna Majiwe Beach Lodge sits right on the beach in Paje, along Zanzibar’s east coast. There are 20 bandas – every one furnished thoughtfully and stylishly, so you can stay in comfort and peace. Choose a garden room for two, a double room with ocean view for no more than three guests, or a family room with garden view and two bedrooms. In each banda you find handcrafted traditional furniture, Wi-Fi, a four-poster bed with a mosquito net and a spacious ensuite bathroom… plus your own terrace with a swing and a view of the turquoise-blue ocean! Cool off in the pool, lie back on a sun lounger or try a cocktail at the pool bar. The restaurant cooks authentic Swahili-Zanzibari dishes using fresh vegetables harvested locally.
